summary: CONX Corp. filed an 8-K regarding entry into a material definitive Agreement and Plan of Merger on May 29, 2026, whereby its wholly owned subsidiary HC2 Merger Sub, LLC will merge with HC2 Broadcasting Holdings Inc. (HC2). Upon closing, HC2 common stock will be converted into the right to receive 25% of surviving entity shares, while Merger Sub interests become 75%, reflecting extinguishment of loans and $75 million in equity commitments. Board recommendation and advisor not named. Closing subject to FCC and HSR approvals, plus loan conditions, with outside date November 29, 2026 (extendable). Watch for regulatory timeline and equity funding mechanics.
